name: AJ Square Testimonial Slider
author: Jahid Shah

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to create a testimonial slider to showcase your client feedback professionally. You can easily manage testimonials, customize colors, and display them using shortcodes. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Key Features:

  • Create unlimited testimonial sliders
  • Display testimonials in a slider format
  • Add specific testimonials to a custom slider
  • Auto-fetch and display recent testimonials
  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly
  • Shortcodes and widget support
  • Easy to install and configure
  • Unlimited color customization

Customization Options:

  • Change slider background color from WordPress Dashboard.
  • Change text color and typography.
  • Adjust slider image height and border radius.

Support & Contact

For any issues, please open a support ticket in the WordPress plugin repository or visit our support page.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 4.5 or greater
  • PHP version 7.4 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater

Installation Process

  1. Automatic Installation (Recommended):

    • Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
    • Navigate to “Plugins > Add New”.
    • Search for “AJ Square Testimonial Slider”.
    • Click “Install Now” and then activate the plugin.

  2. Manual Installation:

    • Download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress plugin repository.
    • Upload the aj-square-testimonial-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory using an FTP client or your web hosting file manager.
    • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Usage

  • After installation, you can use the shortcode [ajsqtesl_slider] to add the testimonial slider anywhere on your site.
  • Alternatively, use the Elementor widget to add the slider to your page.
sections.faq:
How do I display the testimonial slider?

Use the [ajsqtesl_slider] shortcode anywhere in your posts, pages, or widgets.

Can I customize the colors?

Yes, you can customize the slider background, text color, and image settings from the WordPress dashboard.

Is this plugin responsive?

Yes, the slider is fully responsive and works well on all devices.
